title: Version Conflict
statement: Implement `solve(stored, client, new_value)`. If `client` equals `stored`, return `{"version": stored + 1, "value": new_value}`. Otherwise return `conflict`. The successful write bumps the version by 1.
hints: On a match, add 1 to the version and keep the new value.
On a miss, return the string conflict.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: Two clients that read version 3 and both write will lose one update if the second overwrites the first.

editorial: Two clients that read version 3 and both write will lose one update if the second overwrites the first. Comparing the version and updating only when it matches turns the second write into a 409. The client refetches. The stored version advances by one on success.
